description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 11i(b&c) (Contaminated Land) of planning permission ref. 77097/APP/2024/2693, dated 09-07-25 (Erection of a two storey, 2- bed attached dwelling with associated cycle storage and amenity space)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Condition 11(i)(a) attached to planning permission ref. 77097/APP/2024/2693 has been discharged under a previous application reference 77097/APP/2025/3015. The details submitted under this application are considered satisfactory to discharge Condition 11(i)(b & c) only.

The requirements of Condition 11(ii-iv), relating to unexpected contamination, verification reporting and imported soil, remain outstanding and further details must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before these parts of the condition can be discharged.
